description: Initial English field-guide retrieval smoke set. Authored alongside the guides; not an independent farmer-language or regional benchmark. Uses the same domain filters as soil-unit chat.

Some plants along the drip line stay dry. What measurements should I collect before deciding what is wrong?
The sprinklers leave dry patches when it is windy. How can I check the water distribution?
Water gets to the far end of the furrow much later. What times do I need to record to evaluate this irrigation?
My plants have yellow leaves and wilting patches. What should I record before deciding whether this is a disease?
